description: Amity University Madhya Pradesh (AUMP) is a private university established at Gwalior under Madhya Pradesh law. Its 102-acre campus is opposite Gwalior Airport and offers professional, industry-oriented programmes across areas including engineering, management, architecture, biotechnology, law, journalism and mass communication, psychology, and fashion.
